I replied in the #coastal-team thread: Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on November 3, 2025.

- **Official date:** Moss's Coastal digest of Nov 2, 2025 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap from Dec 8, 2025 gives the same date.
- **Handover to Kwame:** The recap also says Bettina kept running the account day to day until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 if the coverage tracker needs the date he actually started working it.
